sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on auxiliary 
 transformers, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in 
 the title block.

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshbah, tested by eng. Reda 
 Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, approved by eng. 
 Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and certified by eng. 
 Sania Diab Attia Diab : WDEPC Inspection head sector 
 and MPIS coordinator.

A 
 work permit must be issued.

The 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear 
 safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc

items: The transformer must be was isolated and proper grounding is required.

There is a danger of falling into the oil containments pit when working near 
 large power transformers.

There is danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulator, wear safety belt.
Complete tool set.
Digital Avometer, test plug, and test leads.
Megger device.
Blower or vacuum cleaner.
PVC Ladder - Brushes.
Clean all bushings if dirty, and inspect the porcelain for cracks.

Check temperature gauge drag pointer to see if there is evidence of excessive
 loading at some time in the past.

Carryout the Megger check or power factor check of insulation for comparison 
 with previous observations

Make certain that no tools or other objects have been left in or on the 
 transformer .
Clean the coils insulation.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on auxiliary 
 transformers, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in 
 the title block.
Technical 
 Specification
3 phase step down Transformer
Rated power | 1250 KVA
Rated frequency | 50HZ
Rated voltage | LV 0.4 KV, HV 6.3 KV
Type of cooling: | Natural cooling
Winding connection | DYn11
Total mass | 4100kg
The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshbah, tested by eng. Reda 
 Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, approved by eng. 
 Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and certified by eng. 
 Sania Diab Attia Diab : WDEPC Inspection head sector 
 and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued.
The 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear 
 safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
The transformer must be was isolated and proper grounding is required.
There is a danger of falling into the oil containments pit when working near 
 large power transformers.
There is danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulator, wear safety belt.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Digital Avometer, test plug, and test leads.
Megger device.
Blower or vacuum cleaner.
PVC Ladder - Brushes.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean all bushings if dirty, and inspect the porcelain for cracks.
Check temperature gauge drag pointer to see if there is evidence of excessive
 loading at some time in the past.
Carryout the Megger check or power factor check of insulation for comparison 
 with previous observations
Make certain that no tools or other objects have been left in or on the 
 transformer .
Clean the coils insulation.

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة فحص المعدات I1 على المحولات المساعدة، الذي يجب تنفيذه على أساس سنوي كما هو موضح بالرمز Y1 في خانة العنوان أعلاه.

rows: الجهد المنخفض 0.4 ك.ف، الجهد العالي 6.3 ك.ف

sections_ar.text: أعد المسودة الأولى م. Ashraf Kamal Oshbah، واختبرها م. Reda Ragab Karam، وقبلها المدير العام م. Hamdy Dorgam، واعتمدها م. Gaber Mohamed Farahat رئيس قطاع محطة Damanhour، ووثقتها م. Sania Diab Attia Diab رئيس قطاع التفتيش في WDEPC ومنسقة MPIS.
يجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة (بطاقة التعريف).
يلزم وجود سياج أمان بعلامات تحذيرية يحيط بمنطقة العمل
ارتدِ مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية مثل خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة... إلخ

items: يجب أن يكون المحول معزولًا ومؤرضًا تأريضًا سليمًا.
يوجد خطر السقوط في حفرة تجميع الزيت عند العمل بالقرب من محولات القدرة الكبيرة.
يوجد خطر السقوط من أعلى المحول عند تنظيف العوازل، ارتدِ حزام السلامة.
طقم عدد كامل.
أفوميتر رقمي، وقابس اختبار، وأسلاك اختبار.
جهاز ميجر.
منفاخ هواء أو مكنسة كهربائية.
سلم PVC - فرش.
نظّف جميع عوازل الاختراق إذا كانت متسخة، وافحص الخزف من حيث التشققات.
افحص المؤشر الساحب لمقياس درجة الحرارة لمعرفة ما إذا كان هناك دليل على تحميل زائد في وقت سابق.
أجرِ فحص الميجر أو فحص معامل القدرة للعزل لمقارنته بالملاحظات السابقة
تأكد من عدم ترك أي عدد أو أشياء أخرى داخل المحول أو عليه.
نظّف عزل الملفات.
